The '''Secure Route ID-5N''', also known as the '''New Route'''<ref name="SWG:JTL" /> due to its creation during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> was a secure space travel [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] located in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] that linked the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:JTL" /> While the route often fluctuated due to the planets' [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] movements, it was a fast and safe way to move between the two worlds.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The ID-5N was patrolled by the [[Corellian Security Force]] constantly.<ref name="SWG:JTL" />
